cause: The original tracking-lock macro ignored both raw-storage allocation and OS lock initialization failure, then allocator tracking acquired an absent lock.
changes: Return the actual tracking-lock storage or OS initialization failure before linking any allocator tracking.
Free only acquired raw storage when backing lock initialization fails; reset the memory initialization reference/state.
Propagate memory failure from portInitialize and unwind only previously started sync/debug modules and its reserved runtime reference.
Make original coreShutdownRm refuse teardown when the portable runtime never acquired an initialization reference, preventing failure-cleanup underflow.

combined_integration.note: Standalone source hashes above describe this patch alone. The combined control also applies the system lifetime overlay and compiles the merged system.c once.

darwin_cross_compile.compiler: Clang 22 through Zig cross compiler, not authoritative Apple compiler execution

profile.internal_abi_change: portMemInitialize changes from void to NV_STATUS inside the isolated full-RM image. All callers and declarations must be rebuilt with the checked overlay header.
profile.module_initialization_serialization: Outer lifecycle lease; no new concurrent-initializer guarantee is introduced.

scope: Checked portable memory tracking-lock initialization and balanced refusal cleanup. No hardware operations or kernel entry changes.

targeted_validation.control: Original ELF full-RM development control; newly adapted TUs replace their original definitions. Platform and privileged CR4 fixtures are explicit.
